title: Aromatic Ukrainian Grape Leaves Stew
description: A hearty, earthy one-pot Ukrainian stew featuring grape leaves, a fragrant soffritto base, and a nut-free-friendly twist, wrapped in ti-leaf-wrap vessels for a rustic finish.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat and sauté diced onion until translucent.
Add minced garlic, diced carrot, and celery, cooking until vegetables soften.
Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute to bloom flavors.
Pour in white wine to deglaze, letting it reduce by half.
Add shredded grape leaves, vegetable broth, paprika, dill, and salt, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a gentle boil, then reduce heat, cover, and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove the pot from heat and let the stew cool slightly; spoon portions into fresh grape leaves to form wraps.
Fold leaves into tight wraps, place seam side down, and steam in a steamer basket for 10 minutes before serving.
